product_overview: The Work Order Module within NetManager provides a comprehensive system to manage maintenance and service requests across various internal departments and physical sites. It standardizes work order creation with templates and integrates securely with existing user authentication systems.
core_goals: Enable efficient creation, tracking, and management of work orders to improve maintenance workflows.
Organize work orders by departments and sites for better responsibility and location management.
Provide standardized templates for recurring work orders to ensure consistency and reduce manual entry.
Securely manage user access and authentication to ensure authorized operations within the module.
key_features: Comprehensive Work Order Management allowing creation, listing, detail viewing, and updating of work orders.
Department management for organizing work orders according to internal organizational units.
Site management for associating work orders with physical locations, supporting geolocation and site details.
Template system for standardized and reusable work order creation processes.
User Authentication integration leveraging NextAuth.js for secure login and session management.
user_flow_summary: Users log in via secure authentication mechanism (NextAuth.js).
Users navigate to the Work Order dashboard to view the list of work orders filtered by department or site.
Users create new work orders using templates or from scratch, providing details on tasks and assignments.
Users update or track the status of work orders through detailed views.
Administrators manage departments and sites to maintain accurate organizational and location data within the system.
validation_criteria: All work order CRUD operations function correctly including creation, retrieval, update, and deletion.
Departments and sites can be added, edited, and removed with immediate effect on filtering and organizing work orders.
Templates for work orders are accessible and applied properly during new work order creation.
User authentication enforces access controls correctly, preventing unauthorized access to the module features.
UI components demonstrate responsive behavior adhering to Tailwind CSS styling and support across supported devices and browsers.
